subject: Mythology
title: Norse Myths in Modern Pop Culture
description: A fast breakdown of Norse Myths in Modern Pop Culture for builders.

hook.text: Marvel's Thor is the most famous Norse god today, but the comics changed almost everything about him.

buildup.text: Tolkien drew deeply from Norse myths. Middle-earth, dwarves, elves, and rings of power all trace back to the Eddas.

discovery.text: Video games like God of War and Assassin's Creed Valhalla brought Norse mythology to a new generation.

twist.text: Most modern versions strip away the fatalism. Real Norse myths were darker: the gods always lose in the end.

climax.text: Despite the changes, pop culture keeps these ancient stories alive for millions who might never read the originals.

punchline.text: Hollywood gave Thor a happy ending the Vikings never did.

quiz.question: Which famous author drew heavily from Norse mythology?
options: C.S. Lewis for the Chronicles of Narnia
J.R.R. Tolkien for Middle-earth and Lord of the Rings
George R.R. Martin for Game of Thrones
